post.summary: Create a NEW empty local database and private runtime configuration
post.description: Loopback clients and local Host only. Requires a CSRF session but no login. Existing databases/configurations are never overwritten. SQL administrator credentials are used only during this request. Required SQL server permissions: CREATE DATABASE, CREATE USER and granting the database-level runtime privileges.

409.description: Already configured, existing database name, or another installation in progress

422.description: Validation, PHP requirements, SQL credentials or provisioning failed. Partially created NEW database may be retained; configuration is not activated.

503.description: Invalid existing configuration or unavailable private storage
